headline: Binance began reopening withdrawals for more coins today as daily outflows slow, while Americans vote in midterms that crypto PACs spent some $170M on.

market.asOf: Read about 04:00 UTC Tue 3 Nov (11:00 Bangkok) from the CoinMarketCap homepage; Fear & Greed from Alternative.me. Use the live prices at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 37 (Fear), up from 34 yesterday, on the Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index; CoinMarketCap's own index reads 33 (Fear)

stories.title: Binance reopens more coins and networks today as money leaving slows down
stories.summary: Binance began reopening withdrawals for more assets at 04:00 UTC today, on networks including Ethereum, Solana, XRP Ledger and Base, after its hack. The amount customers pull out each day has dropped by more than half from the peak. A new reserve check says ten major coins are backed one-to-one, and another snapshot is due Wednesday.
points: Binance is reopening more assets on BNB Smart Chain, Ethereum, Solana, XRP Ledger, Sui, Arbitrum, Optimism, Tron and Base, per Reuters via The Star.

Net outflows were $2.57B on Monday, down from $6.1B on Sunday, per Cointelegraph via cryptonews.net. The Block, using DeFiLlama data, put 24h net outflows at about $3.29B on Monday, more than 50% below a peak of about $7B.
Binance's new zero-knowledge proof-of-reserves snapshot covers 10 assets including BTC, ETH, USDT and BNB, which it says are backed 1:1, per The Block.
Binance says it has replaced about 95% of the hacked assets with its own funds, per The Block.
Another snapshot is planned for Wednesday 4 Nov, with the full proof about 40 to 50 hours after it, per The Block.

sources.label: Reuters via The Star: Binance reopens more networks

stories.title: Americans vote in the midterms today after record crypto spending
stories.summary: Control of Congress is decided today. The three biggest crypto super PACs spent some $170M, mostly backing Republicans. The first polls close at 6:00pm ET, which is 06:00 Wednesday in Bangkok.
points: The three leading crypto super PACs spent some $170M, mostly favouring Republicans, per CoinDesk.
Fairshake and its affiliates put $154M toward candidates and keep a $56M reserve for the next cycle, per CoinDesk.
About $56M went to defeating Democrat Sherrod Brown in the Ohio Senate race, per CoinDesk.
Kalshi markets gave about a 70% chance of Democrats winning both chambers, per CoinDesk.
First polls close at 6:00pm ET (06:00 Wed Bangkok) and the last, in Alaska, at 1:00am ET (13:00 Wed Bangkok), per 270toWin.

stories.title: Bitcoin funds see their biggest outflow since June as crypto stocks slide
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin funds lost about $643M on Friday, their biggest one-day outflow since late June, wiping out most of this year's net inflow. Coinbase shares fell about 4% on Monday.
points: US spot bitcoin ETFs had net outflows of about $643.3M on Friday 30 Oct, the largest since 25 June, per CoinDesk.
BlackRock's IBIT lost about $233.7M and Fidelity's FBTC about $201.4M, per CoinDesk.
Friday's outflow erased about 63.6% of 2026's net inflow of just over $1B, per CoinDesk.
Coinbase fell 3.98% to $137.83 on Monday, per The Block; Ark Invest bought about $3.4M of Coinbase shares, per The Block.

sources.label: The Block: Ark buys Coinbase, Circle, Robinhood

briefs.title: Australia raises rates to 4.85%
briefs.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia raised its cash rate 25 basis points to 4.85% from 4.60% on a 6-3 vote, and expects inflation to stay above 3% over the coming year.

briefs.title: About half the Binance loot is still in hacker wallets
briefs.summary: Elliptic says $3.24B is still in theft-linked addresses and $2.85B (about 44%) is frozen or seized; the 18,270 BTC stolen directly has not moved, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: North Korea rejects the FBI's hack finding
briefs.summary: Kim Yo-jong rejected the FBI's finding that North Korea carried out the Binance hack, per The Block citing Yonhap.

briefs.title: Separate $106M theft from an EU entity
briefs.summary: Investigator ZachXBT flagged more than $106M stolen from exchange accounts of an unnamed EU entity on 1 Nov and has 'high confidence' it was not Lazarus, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Brazil's Mercado Bitcoin breach
briefs.summary: About $46.3M of assets were involved per Arkham data, Tether froze more than 4.5M USDT, and the exchange says customers were not affected, per The Block.

briefs.title: Strategy buys 811 BTC
briefs.summary: Strategy bought 811 BTC for about $65.5M and now holds 849,327 BTC at an average cost of $75,451, per The Block.

briefs.title: Kenya's crypto grace period ends 4 Nov
briefs.summary: Kenya's grace period for existing crypto firms ends on 4 Nov, per CoinDesk's week ahead.
